name: Duke Cell Biology Academy (CeBA)
org: Duke University Department of Cell Biology
what_you_do: This is six weeks of paid summer research in a Duke cell biology lab. You work with a graduate student or postdoc. You do your own project. There are career seminars and journal clubs.
who_can_apply: High school sophomores, juniors and seniors in 2026-27 who are at least 15 by June 1, 2027 and from the Research Triangle area. Needs a Social Security Number or ITIN to receive the stipend. Students must provide their own transportation.
pay_detail: $2,400 awarded on completion of the program
duration: 6 weeks (2026: June 22 to July 31), about 9 am to 5 pm on site
deadline_text: The page says Summer 2026 applications are closed and Summer 2027 applications will be accepted in January 2027. 2026 deadline: the flyer says March 20, 2026 and the FAQ says March 27, 2026 at 5 pm.
how_to_apply: Online application plus a recommendation letter (links on the CeBA page). Applicants hear back in mid-April.
notes: The 2026 deadline is stated two ways. It is March 20 on the flyer and March 27 in the FAQ. The page says there is no housing or transportation help, so only local students are considered. The $2,400 is a completion award. Paid work for people under 18 in North Carolina needs a Youth Employment Certificate. See permit.html?state=nc for the exact permit and steps.
